description: This file is a test configuration script for pytest, setting up fixtures and test collection modifications specific to the 'litellm' project. It manages event loops, reloads modules, and organizes test execution order based on test names and contexts.

methods.name: event_loop()
methods.description: Pytest fixture that provides an asyncio event loop for tests, creating a new one if none is running.

methods.name: setup_and_teardown(event_loop)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that sets up the test environment by configuring sys.path, importing modules, clearing logs, reloading modules, and cleaning up pending asyncio tasks after tests.

methods.name: pytest_collection_modifyitems(config, items)
methods.description: Pytest hook that reorganizes test order, prioritizing tests related to custom_logger.

ctags.name: setup_and_teardown
ctags.pattern: /^def setup_and_teardown(event_loop):  # Add event_loop as a dependency$/
